item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "11d07619ae28a7da0cee8f8bb9e50336866d7604f4a25521a071b055f7d65946",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "Maps a real number c to the matrix A indexed by Fin 1 in both coordinates with A(i,j)=c.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coefficient matrix is the one-by-one matrix [speed].",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "An abbreviation for LocalDef005 with component index type Fin m.",
      "effect_on_target": "The left side uses the vector derivative and matrix equation predicate with m=1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "An abbreviation for LocalDef006 specialized to real-valued q.",
      "effect_on_target": "The right side requires real partial derivative witnesses satisfying qt + speed*qx = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "Maps q to Q defined by Q(x,t)(i)=q(x,t) for every i in Fin 1.",
      "effect_on_target": "Embeds the scalar field as a field with exactly one real component.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "For a finite index type ι, a vector-valued field Q, matrix A, and point (x,t), there exist vectors qt and qx such that the derivative of τ↦Q(x,τ) at t is qt, the derivative of ξ↦Q(ξ,t) at x is qx, and qt+A*qx=0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the left side as the conjunction of two derivative assertions and one vector equality under two existential quantifiers.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "For a field q valued in a real normed vector space E, there exist qt,qx in E such that the time and space slices have these derivatives at t and x, respectively, and qt+speed•qx=0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specialized to E=Real, this defines the right side using ordinary multiplication by speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "LocalDef007",
      "meaning": "For every index type ι, real scalar multiplication on ι→Real is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of scalar multiplication for the vector-valued derivative predicate; it adds no assumption on q.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "LocalDef008",
      "meaning": "Scalar multiplication on every real normed vector space is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the continuity structure needed by the scalar-side derivative predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence: each of two propositions implies the other.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts equivalence of the vector and scalar conditions, not their unconditional truth.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the type of the dimension parameter, instantiated as 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural numeral using the supplied OfNat instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets the explicit dimension numeral as the natural number 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "All independent variables, the speed, scalar field values, and vector entries are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "instOfNatNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral n in Nat as n itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the component count to exactly one.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin n is the type of natural numbers strictly less than n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fin 1 has exactly the index 0; vector equality is therefore a single component equality.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates all elements of Fin n without duplicates.",
      "effect_on_target": "The matrix-vector sum runs over the single index in Fin 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Matrix",
      "meaning": "A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entries in α is a function m→n→α.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coefficient is a function on two singleton index types with value speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Gives a normed field its normed vector space structure over itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Real scalar multiplication on Real is field multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The real additive group with its usual norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar codomain's normed additive structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field equipped with its usual compatible norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary real arithmetic and the normed field structure for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts a SubtractionCommMonoid structure from an additive commutative group, preserving subtraction and negation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited additive infrastructure without imposing an additional condition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "AddCommMagma.toAdd",
      "meaning": "Extracts the addition operation from a commutative additive magma.",
      "effect_on_target": "Resolves addition in the derivative equations to the inherited addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Forgets the zero and identity requirements of an additive commutative monoid while preserving addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the structure path supplying addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma",
      "meaning": "Retains the commutative addition operation from an additive commutative semigroup.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the addition used in the equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, zero, and the additive identity laws from an additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies compatible addition and zero for the equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "AddZero.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts the zero element from an AddZero structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the zero appearing on the right of the derivative equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "AddZeroClass.toAddZero",
      "meaning": "Retains addition and zero from an additive identity structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the zero and addition used by the target predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both derivative assertions and the corresponding equation must hold for the same witnesses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "A densely normed field has a nontrivial norm, with its normed field structure retained.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the nontrivially normed real domain required for HasDerivAt.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul",
      "meaning": "Retains scalar multiplication and its preservation of zero and addition from a distributive multiplicative action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the module structure to the scalar multiplication in the scalar equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains scalar multiplication and its preservation of zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the scalar action used to multiply qx by speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure from a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real semiring operations for module and matrix constructions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets definiteness from an extended-normed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited structure while preserving the addition and zero used here.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid from an extended-seminormed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the existing addition and zero; no extended-real unknown is introduced.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets commutativity from an extended-seminormed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "An inheritance step preserving the additive operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid from an extended-seminormed additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary addition and zero through the inherited structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The vector equation is equality of functions, hence componentwise equality; the scalar equation is real equality.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over a specified type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Each side independently asserts existence of a time derivative witness followed by a space derivative witness.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains the semifield structure of a field, with the same arithmetic operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports real semiring and module structure without restricting speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A finite type equipped with a complete finite enumeration.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes matrix-vector multiplication a finite sum; the target uses the singleton Fin 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "The addition operation selected by a heterogeneous addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here it is ordinary real addition or pointwise vector addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "The scalar action selected by a heterogeneous scalar multiplication instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "In the scalar predicate it is multiplication of the real witness qx by speed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "Asserts that f has derivative f' at x, using the derivative filter with variable point approaching x and base point fixed at x.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires actual ordinary derivatives of the two one-variable slices at the specified points, with no restriction to a subset.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "Matrix.mulVec",
      "meaning": "For each row i, (M*v)(i) is the dot product of row i with v, namely the finite sum of M(i,j)*v(j).",
      "effect_on_target": "For the matrix [speed], the unique component is speed*qx(0).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive multiplicative scalar action from a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the same scalar multiplication as the real vector space structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "NegZeroClass.toZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts zero from a structure in which negation preserves zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the inherited additive zero in the scalar equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets associativity from a nonunital commutative ring structure while preserving its operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the algebraic structure required by matrix multiplication without changing real arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplication commutativity while retaining the nonunital nonassociative ring operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "An inheritance step for the real operations used by mulVec.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, zero, multiplication, and distributive laws while forgetting additive inverses.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the structure needed to form the matrix-vector finite sum.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid underlying a nonunital nonassociative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides finite-sum addition and zero for matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital commutative ring from a normed one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real arithmetic used in the matrix expression.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplication commutativity from a nonunital seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "An inherited structure path to the additive and topological structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group, and pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive and metric structure underlying the derivative codomain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplication associativity from a nonunital semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Another inheritance path supplying the algebra required by mulVec.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed field structure from a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real norm and arithmetic used in differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "An additive commutative group equipped with a norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "The general scalar predicate requires this codomain structure, instantiated by Real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative group from a normed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition, subtraction, and zero needed by derivatives and the scalar equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Views a normed additive commutative group as an extended-normed additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves its additive operations and topology through an alternative structure path.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group, and pseudometric while forgetting norm definiteness.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the seminormed structure required by the normed space instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the multiplicative unit requirement of a normed commutative ring while preserving its operations and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports matrix arithmetic using the same real addition and multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Views a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same norm and arithmetic.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real metric and algebra along an inherited structure path.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the field structure underlying a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real field operations for scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "NormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A module over a normed field whose scalar multiplication satisfies the norm compatibility inequality.",
      "effect_on_target": "The general scalar predicate uses a real normed vector space; the target fixes that space to Real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure from a normed space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar action in HasDerivAt and in speed•qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "Gives functions I→β the pointwise module structure inherited from β.",
      "effect_on_target": "The one-component codomain is a real vector space with coordinatewise scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Gives a family of functions the coordinatewise additive commutative group structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the vector codomain's additive group for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Pi.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Defines function addition by (f+g)(i)=f(i)+g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "The vector equation's unique component is qt(0)+speed*qx(0)=0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Pi.instZero",
      "meaning": "Defines the zero function to be zero at every coordinate.",
      "effect_on_target": "The vector equation is equality to the zero vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Equips a function space with the product topology induced by all coordinate evaluations.",
      "effect_on_target": "The vector derivative uses the product topology; with one real coordinate it has the same convergence behavior as Real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the usual real distance to the topology used by derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed field has elements with norms strictly between any two given positive real bounds.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the nontrivial norm structure on the real differentiation domain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "The real addition operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "The scalar equation and vector component equation use ordinary real addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group structure of Real.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real additive operations and laws for both predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "Real.instMonoid",
      "meaning": "The multiplicative monoid structure of Real.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the scalar action structure; zero speed remains allowed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "The ring structure of Real.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the standard arithmetic underlying the derivative equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real number zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the scalar zero and every component of the vector zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Real with its commutative ring operations and usual compatible norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies compatible real algebraic and topological structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real distance is d(x,y)=|x-y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative domain and real codomain use the usual real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The semiring structure of Real with its usual operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real operations for modules and finite matrix sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "Ring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure of a ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves ordinary real arithmetic in the module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "SMulZeroClass.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from a scalar action preserving zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects the inherited action for speed•qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplication commutativity from a semifield while retaining its division semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "An inheritance step supplying the real semiring used in scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric structure of a seminormed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the metric-derived topology used in the scalar derivative predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the unit requirement while preserving a seminormed commutative ring's arithmetic, norm, and pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "An inheritance step preserving real topology and addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Forgets the unit requirement of a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the weaker real algebraic structure accepted by matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "SubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass",
      "meaning": "Retains zero, negation, and the law that negating zero gives zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Part of the inheritance path selecting the additive zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "SubtractionCommMonoid.toSubtractionMonoid",
      "meaning": "Forgets addition commutativity while preserving the subtraction monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "An additive structure projection with no new restriction on the target variables.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains subtraction and negation and supplies the law that negation preserves zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the zero and additive operations used in the equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D088",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology underlying a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the usual metric-derived topology on Real for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D089",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 as the zero element of the relevant type.",
